info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Payments Payments Void-v4-spec
info.description: The Void Payment API allows businesses to reverse or cancel payments that have been processed. This operation is essential for managing errors, refunds, or disputes, ensuring that transactions can be efficiently corrected. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment processing systems, this API enables them to maintain accurate financial records and enhance customer service. Users can initiate void requests based on specific payment identifiers, making it straightforward to manage payment statuses effectively.

delete.description: This operation allows you to void a previously completed payment transaction, reversing the transaction and ensuring that funds are not captured. It is important to call this operation for any payment that needs to be canceled before it is processed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to void a payment transaction. Ensure that all necessary information is correctly provided to successfully process the void operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, voiding the payment.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: Request body for voiding a payment operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the void operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a successful void operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the void operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the void operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema containing audit information for the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the request in milliseconds.

schema.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
